text:
oncall-robin: seeing a sharp 5xx spike on /v1/generate, started ~02:03 UTC. Error rate jumped to ~15% for hosted customers in us-west-2.
incident-bot: ALERT created (P1) — paging oncall. Autoscaling events: multiple fallbacks to 'dedicated-pool-03' flagged.
laura-eng-runtime: logs show routing decision history: a subset of hosted tenant requests matched a fallback policy because label 'capacity_tier:dedicated' was applied by the new rollout rule. suspect policy matcher precedence bug.
mike-sre: confirmed: dedicated pool saw a surge of requests not belonging to its reserved tenant list. KV cache pressure + OOMs in ded nodes.
oncall-robin: is this the new routing policy we rolled at 01:45?
laura-eng-runtime: yes — rollout 'smart-fallback/v2' went live in us-* yesterday. Rule snippet:```yaml
- match: tenant.attributes.cap_tier == "dedicated" or (region=="us-west-2" and allow_burst)
  action: route_to: dedicated
```
laura-eng-runtime: the bug is precedence — the 'allow_burst' flag is true for some hosted traffic due to an earlier feature flag, so they qualify incorrectly.
mike-sre: mitigation plan: 1) disable fallback_to_dedicated in the policy engine for hosted tenants, 2) drain/evict non-owner connections from dedicated-pool-03, 3) ramp up hosted capacity throttles. I'll run step 1 now.
mike-sre: (executing) `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/policies/rollback -d '{"policy":"smart-fallback/v2","field":"fallback_to_dedicated","value":false}'`
mike-sre: response 200 OK — rollback applied in control plane, propagating to us-west-2.
incident-bot: POLICY change recorded by mike-sre. Propagation ETA 45s.
oncall-robin: can we confirm traffic shift? watch logs and errors.
laura-eng-runtime: watching. error rate dropped to 6% within 90s. backend 5xx from ded nodes dropping.
mike-sre: initiating connection eviction on dedicated-pool-03: `kubectl exec -n ded ... evict --selector=non_owner=true` — starting now.
ingela-platform: added temporary ACL to reject hosted tenant ids at LB level for ded pool while eviction finishes. Command: `lbctl deny --target=ded-03 --tag=hosted_ids --duration=10m`.
laura-eng-runtime: cache invalidation note: some long-running KV sessions persisted cause brief 502s during eviction, expected.
oncall-robin: customer impact — CS, which tenants did we see leak?
jess-cs: initial list from logs: tenant-a.co, tenant-x-saas, tenant-psi. I'm drafting a short incident notification — will send as soon as we confirm final impact window (02:03–02:12 UTC).
samir-oncall: I'll take the handoff in 10 min. Current status pls.
oncall-robin: status: rollback deployed, fallback disabled, dedicated pool being drained, errors trending back down to baseline (~0.5%). Keep page open for post-mortem. Samir — I'll hand you the incident once eviction completes.
mike-sre: eviction finished at +9m. ded pool CPU returning to normal. No sign of persistent tenant data leakage.
laura-eng-runtime: root cause hypothesis: precedence bug in the policy matcher together with a feature flag 'allow_burst' that was enabled for a pilot set of hosted tenants. Combined condition matched hosted traffic and routed them to dedicated fallback.
INGELA-PLATFORM: note for RCA — control plane rollout did not gate policy by tenant isolation metadata. We'll include patch and test matrix.
samir-oncall: taking over. Actions for oncall->owner: 1) create RCA ticket, 2) revert rollout in all regions for smart-fallback/v2 until tests added, 3) add unit/e2e checks for precedence and tenant isolation, 4) coordinate customer notifications.
jess-cs: customer notifications queued — sent initial "we experienced brief degraded performance" to tenant-a.co and tenant-psi; tenant-x-saas requested SLA credit, escalated to account team.
incident-bot: INCIDENT resolved (brief mitigation window 02:03–02:12 UTC). Severity: P1->remediated. Please file RCA and post follow-up in #incidents.
oncall-robin: thanks team — documented steps in oncall runbook. Samir, handoff complete. :thumbsup:
samir-oncall: acknowledged — will open RCA and tag eng-runtime, platform, SRE, and CS. Closing thread in 1h unless new regressions show up.
